segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Elena has a **red** **bicycle** near her home. It is new, but she cannot ride it yet. She looks at the quiet **street** and wants to try today.

paragraphs.translation_ar: لدى إيلينا دراجة حمراء قرب منزلها. إنها جديدة، لكنها لا تستطيع ركوبها بعد. تنظر إلى الشارع الهادئ وتريد التجربة اليوم.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: I have my yellow **helmet**, Elena says.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: That is good, Ben says.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Elena feels **nervous** because she may fall. She wants to **ride** but holds the bicycle very tightly.

paragraphs.translation_ar: تقول إيلينا: «معي خوذتي الصفراء». يقول بن: «هذا جيد». تشعر إيلينا بالتوتر لأنها قد تسقط. تريد الركوب لكنها تمسك الدراجة بقوة.

blocks.image_prompt: A bicycle with one flat tire on a quiet lane, Elena looks worried and Ben points toward a small repair shop, mid shot. Consistent characters: Elena: A 12-year-old girl with short curly dark hair, olive skin, an orange hoodie, blue jeans, white trainers, bright yellow bicycle helmet.. Ben: A 12-year-old boy with straight light brown hair, fair skin, a sky-blue jacket, dark jeans, black trainers.. Warm educational watercolor schoolbook, medium detail, soft natural lighting, no text in image.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Her **friend** Ben walks beside the bicycle.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: Look forward, he says.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Elena tries to keep her **balance**. She moves **slowly** and smiles when the bicycle goes a little farther.

paragraphs.translation_ar: يمشي صديقها بن بجوار الدراجة. يقول: «انظري إلى الأمام». تحاول إيلينا الحفاظ على توازنها. تتحرك ببطء وتبتسم عندما تتقدم الدراجة قليلًا.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Suddenly, the back **wheel** feels strange. It is **flat**, and the bicycle does not move well.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: We must **stop**, Elena says. Ben checks the wheel and nods.

paragraphs.translation_ar: فجأة تبدو العجلة الخلفية غريبة. إنها فارغة من الهواء، ولا تتحرك الدراجة جيدًا. تقول إيلينا: «يجب أن نتوقف». يفحص بن العجلة ويوافق.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: They walk to a little **shop** at the end of the street. It is **closed** today.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: We can come back **tomorrow**, Ben says. Elena agrees and takes her bicycle home.

paragraphs.translation_ar: يمشيان إلى محل صغير في نهاية الشارع. إنه مغلق اليوم. يقول بن: «يمكننا العودة غدًا». توافق إيلينا وتأخذ دراجتها إلى المنزل.

blocks.image_prompt: Ben holds a bicycle pump as Elena puts on a yellow helmet beside a garden gate, warm next morning light, side view. Consistent characters: Elena: A 12-year-old girl with short curly dark hair, olive skin, an orange hoodie, blue jeans, white trainers, bright yellow bicycle helmet.. Ben: A 12-year-old boy with straight light brown hair, fair skin, a sky-blue jacket, dark jeans, black trainers.. Warm educational watercolor schoolbook, medium detail, soft natural lighting, no text in image.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: On Sunday, Ben brings a **pump** from his father. They put **air** into the wheel.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: Now I am **ready**, Elena says. She puts on her helmet and checks the bicycle.

paragraphs.translation_ar: يوم الأحد، يجلب بن مضخة من أبيه. يضعان الهواء في العجلة. تقول إيلينا: «أنا مستعدة الآن». ترتدي خوذتها وتفحص الدراجة.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: They **practice** in a quiet park. Ben asks Elena to be **careful** near a big **turn**. She listens and moves her bicycle around the path without a fall.

paragraphs.translation_ar: يتدربان في حديقة هادئة. يطلب بن من إيلينا أن تكون حذرة قرب منعطف كبير. تستمع وتحرك دراجتها حول الممر دون أن تسقط.

blocks.image_prompt: Elena rides the red bicycle confidently around a safe park path while Ben cheers, golden afternoon lighting, wide view. Consistent characters: Elena: A 12-year-old girl with short curly dark hair, olive skin, an orange hoodie, blue jeans, white trainers, bright yellow bicycle helmet.. Ben: A 12-year-old boy with straight light brown hair, fair skin, a sky-blue jacket, dark jeans, black trainers.. Warm educational watercolor schoolbook, medium detail, soft natural lighting, no text in image.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: A little **dog** runs near the **path**. Elena rings her **bell** and rides more slowly.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: That was good, Ben says. The dog moves away, and the path is clear again.

paragraphs.translation_ar: يركض كلب صغير قرب الممر. تقرع إيلينا جرسها وتبطئ السير. يقول بن: «أحسنت». يبتعد الكلب ويصبح الممر خاليًا مرة أخرى.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Elena feels **brave** now. She rides around the last **corner** and gives Ben a big **smile**.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: I can do it! she says. Ben claps and laughs with her.

paragraphs.translation_ar: تشعر إيلينا بالشجاعة الآن. تدور حول المنعطف الأخير وتعطي بن ابتسامة كبيرة. تقول: «أستطيع فعل ذلك!» يصفق بن ويضحك معها.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Elena knows it is good to be **patient** when you **learn** something new.

segments.speaker: FEMALE
segments.text: Thank you, Ben, she says.

segments.speaker: MALE
segments.text: We did it **together**, he answers. They ride home happily.

paragraphs.translation_ar: تعرف إيلينا أن الصبر مهم عند تعلم شيء جديد. تقول: «شكرًا يا بن». يجيبها: «نجحنا معًا». يعودان إلى المنزل سعيدين.
